functions.name: get_my_fonts
functions.returns: TABLE(font_id uuid, group_id uuid, asset_id uuid, name text, metadata jsonb, download_url text, size bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, font_hash text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_fonts(p_group_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(font_id uuid, group_id uuid, asset_id uuid, name text, metadata jsonb, download_url text, size bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, font_hash text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT f.id, f.group_id, f.asset_id, f.name, f.metadata, a.download_url, a.size, f.created_at, a.hash
  FROM public.fonts f 
  JOIN public.font_assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id
  WHERE (public.is_admin() OR f.user_id = auth.uid()) 
    AND (p_group_id IS NULL OR f.group_id = p_group_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.font_weights fw WHERE fw.child_font_id = f.id
    )
  ORDER BY f.created_at ASC;
$function$

functions.name: get_my_weights
functions.returns: TABLE(font_id uuid, name text, download_url text, font_hash text, size bigint, metadata jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_weights(p_font_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(font_id uuid, name text, download_url text, font_hash text, size bigint, metadata jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_group_id uuid;
    v_font_exists boolean;
BEGIN
    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.fonts WHERE id = p_font_id) INTO v_font_exists;

    IF NOT v_font_exists THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT group_id INTO v_group_id FROM public.fonts WHERE id = p_font_id;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        f.id AS font_id,
        f.name,
        a.download_url,
        a.hash AS font_hash,
        a.size,
        f.metadata
    FROM public.font_weights fw
    JOIN public.fonts f ON f.id = fw.child_font_id
    JOIN public.font_assets a ON a.id = f.asset_id
    WHERE fw.parent_font_id = p_font_id 
      AND (
          v_group_id IS NULL
          OR fw.user_id = auth.uid()
          OR public.is_admin()
      );
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_parent_font_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_parent_font_ids(p_font_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(parent_font_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT fw.parent_font_id
  FROM public.font_weights fw
  JOIN public.fonts f ON f.id = fw.parent_font_id
  WHERE fw.parent_font_id = ANY(p_font_ids)
    AND (
      f.group_id IS NULL
      OR fw.user_id = auth.uid()
      OR public.is_admin()
    );
$function$

functions.name: get_public_fonts
functions.returns: TABLE(font_id uuid, font_name text, download_url text, size bigint, tags jsonb, total_count bigint)
functions.arguments: p_sort text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_fonts(p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(font_id uuid, font_name text, download_url text, size bigint, tags jsonb, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        f.id,
        f.name,
        fa.download_url,
        fa.size,
        f.metadata -> 'tags',
        COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count
    FROM public.fonts f
    JOIN public.font_assets fa ON fa.id = f.asset_id
    WHERE f.group_id IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.font_weights fw WHERE fw.child_font_id = f.id
      )
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN p_sort = 'newest' THEN f.created_at END DESC,
        CASE WHEN p_sort = 'oldest' THEN f.created_at END ASC,
        CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name_asc' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN f.name ~ '^[A-Za-z]' THEN 1
                WHEN f.name ~ '^[\u0600-\u06FF]' THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END
        END ASC,
        CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name_asc' THEN f.name END ASC
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN (
    COALESCE(auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role', '') = 'admin'
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: smart_search
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, name text, tags jsonb, download_url text, total_count bigint)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.smart_search(search_term text, p_mode text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, tags jsonb, download_url text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF p_mode = 'public' THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        WITH filtered_fonts AS (
            SELECT 
                f.id, 
                f.name, 
                COALESCE(f.metadata->'tags', '[]'::jsonb) as tags,
                fa.download_url
            FROM public.fonts f
            JOIN public.font_assets fa ON f.asset_id = fa.id
            WHERE f.group_id IS NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.font_weights fw WHERE fw.child_font_id = f.id)
              AND (f.name ILIKE '%' || search_term || '%' 
                 OR f.metadata->>'tags' ILIKE '%' || search_term || '%')
        )
        SELECT 
            ff.id, ff.name, ff.tags, ff.download_url, 
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_fonts) AS total_count
        FROM filtered_fonts ff
        ORDER BY ff.name ASC 
        LIMIT 5;

    ELSIF p_mode = 'private' THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        WITH filtered_fonts AS (
            SELECT 
                f.id, f.name, '[]'::jsonb as tags, fa.download_url
            FROM public.fonts f
            JOIN public.font_assets fa ON f.asset_id = fa.id
            WHERE f.user_id = v_user_id AND f.group_id IS NOT NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.font_weights fw WHERE fw.child_font_id = f.id)
              AND f.name ILIKE '%' || search_term || '%'
        )
        SELECT 
            ff.id, ff.name, ff.tags, ff.download_url, 
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_fonts) AS total_count
        FROM filtered_fonts ff
        ORDER BY ff.name ASC 
        LIMIT 5;
    ELSE
        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT NULL::uuid, NULL::text, NULL::jsonb, NULL::text, 0::bigint
        WHERE false;
    END IF;
END;
$function$
